meta.name: game-world-design
meta.description: Design game experience, systems, and levels. Converge the chosen concept into one GAME_DESIGN defining the player promise, core loop, how the world responds, the systems actually needed, level pacing, feedback, failure, and a fully playable prototype. Use for design the game world, deepen the gameplay and levels, write the game design document. 游戏体验、系统与关卡策划。把选定概念收束为一份 GAME_DESIGN，定义玩家承诺、核心循环、世界响应、必要系统、关卡节奏、反馈、失败和可完整游玩的原型。用于设计游戏世界、深化玩法和关卡等需求。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把游戏概念收束为可玩原型的设计方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在构思游戏世界、核心循环与关卡体验
copy.tagline_en: Turn a game concept into a playable prototype design
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're defining game worlds, core loops, and level experiences

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把概念收束为一份 GAME_DESIGN.md，定义玩家承诺、核心循环、世界响应、必要系统、关卡节奏、反馈、失败和可完整游玩的原型；需先提供 SOURCE_BIBLE.md、CONCEPT.md 与 PRODUCT_BRIEF.md。
howto.when: 当你说要设计游戏世界、深化玩法/关卡或撰写游戏设计文档，并提供那三个指定文件时触发。

say.text: 按提供的那三个文件，产出一份完整 GAME_DESIGN.md。
say.note: Claude 将读取文件并生成设计文档。

say.text: 深化我选的玩法概念，补上两层循环和决策深度示例表。
say.note: 会检查现有设计并补齐缺失章节。

say.text: 重写我的关卡设计，按五拍节拍写出最小试玩段脚本。
say.note: 产出教会/变式/组合/检验/命运回收各拍内容。

howto.what_en: Given the three required files, Claude produces a GAME_DESIGN.md that defines player promise, core loop, world response, needed systems, level pacing, feedback, failure, and a playable prototype.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to design a game world, deepen gameplay/levels, or write a game design document, and provide the three required files.

say_en.text: Using those three files, produce a complete GAME_DESIGN.md.
say_en.note: Claude will read the files and generate the design document.

say_en.text: Deepen this gameplay concept and add the two-loop and decision-depth example tables.
say_en.note: Checks the existing design and fills missing sections.

say_en.text: Rewrite my level design, with a minimal playtest segment script following the five beats.
